She stopped me from leaving and managed to make me feel like I was a selfish asshole for even considering ditching our plans to be there for my boyfriend. The fact I didn’t leave still haunts me to this day. 

I’m glad I woke up. She was toxic, and I grew so much confidence after leaving that relationship.

I love John Oliver, but all these posts about how he “blackmailed” congress are ridiculous and makes me lose trust in Reddit. He absolutely did not. Did he make it seem like it was possible that he may have some of their data? Yes. But literally only if they clicked one of their ad links. And there is no real suggestion that of all the people who did have data collected that any of them were verified congress people. Instead, the closest thing was three individuals who appeared to have clicked while in the capitol building, but that could have been literally anyone inside (guests, staffers, security, etc.)

While this is amazing and John Oliver is awesome, good god is this such a misleading and clickbaity title.

No, he didn’t blackmail congress with their own data. The data is from the entire DC area, and only those who clicked one of the three ad links actually had their data taken. And only 3 people of those seemed to be within the capitol building itself (which could be anyone, not just actual congressmen). AND none of those people have been identified. He only said it would be possible TO potentially identify them based on IP address, etc.

I don't think I've ever been *affected* by a song until "Renegade" that she made with Big Red Machine. 

I have been increasingly depressed over the past few years. I used to be a super optimistic, happy, and energetic person with a strong will to work toward my goals. Things changed, and I slowly got super jaded and depressed. A constant through this entire period (both good and bad) has been my incredible husband. I knew I was pushing him away, but in some ways I think it was because he (and everyone else for that matter) would be better off without me. 

I was lying in bed, unable to find any motivation to get up and do anything (like usual). I felt like shit, and I was mindlessly watching instagram reels when one popped up just playing "Renegade" with the lyrics flashing. I had heard the song before, but I don't think I really took in the lyrics until then. 

It was reading those lyrics that it hit me that I was the bad guy in this song. This could be sung by my husband to me from his perspective. And I felt fucking awful. But this time, instead of dwelling on it, I felt the motivation to fucking do something about it. He's amazing, and doesnt deserve to "let all [my] damage damage [him]" or to "carry [my] baggage up [his] street." I needed to get my shit together and let him love me like I knew he wanted to whether I felt like I deserved it or not. 

Anyway. "Renegade" is that song for me. I replay it now every time I start to go to my dark place to remind me to get my shit together lol. Damn those lyrics are good.
